jobs.title: AI Strategist
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. 5+ years in product management, solutions engineering, technical consulting, technical program management, or another customer-facing technical role Experience taking complex software, data, machine-learning, or AI initiatives from concept through production and adoption Strong applied AI fluency, including familiarity with LLMs, agents, retrieval, tool use, prompt and context engineering, evaluations, and human-in-the-loop workflows
